instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: The server ___ the logs when the power failed.
questions.explanation: The past continuous marks the longer activity that was running when the failure happened.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي المستمر يحدد النشاط الأطول الذي كان جارياً لحظة حدوث العطل.

questions.question: My brother ___ to Abu Dhabi tonight; the tickets are already booked.
questions.explanation: A fixed future arrangement with a time expression takes the present continuous.
questions.explanation_ar: الترتيب المستقبلي الثابت مع ظرف زمني يأخذ المضارع المستمر.

questions.question: Which question form is correct for a finished past event?
options: Was he liking it last year
Does he like it last year
Did he like it last year
Has he liked it last year
options_en: Was he liking it last year
Does he like it last year
Did he like it last year
Has he liked it last year
questions.explanation: A finished past event with a past time expression takes the past simple question with did.
questions.explanation_ar: الحدث الماضي المنتهي مع ظرف زمني ماضٍ يأخذ سؤال الماضي البسيط بـ did.

questions.question: Which time expression fits: 'He has been learning Arabic ___'?
options: since a very long time now
during a very long time now
within a very long time now
for a very long time now
options_en: since a very long time now
during a very long time now
within a very long time now
for a very long time now
questions.explanation: A duration with the present perfect continuous is introduced by for, not by in, at or on.
questions.explanation_ar: المدة مع المضارع التام المستمر تُقدَّم بـ for لا بـ in أو at أو on.

questions.question: Which time expression fits: 'I wrote to my grandmother ___'?
questions.explanation: The past simple takes a finished-time expression such as the other day.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي البسيط يأخذ ظرف زمن منتهٍ مثل the other day.

questions.question: By the time we arrived, the film ___.
questions.explanation: The past perfect marks the action completed before another past action.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام يدل على الفعل الذي اكتمل قبل فعل ماضٍ آخر.

questions.question: She ___ in Dublin since 2019 and still lives there.
questions.explanation: Since with a present result requires the present perfect, because the situation continues.
questions.explanation_ar: since مع نتيجة حاضرة تتطلب المضارع التام، لأن الحالة مستمرة.

questions.question: Don't call at eight; we ___ dinner then.
questions.explanation: The future continuous describes an activity that will be in progress at a future time.
questions.explanation_ar: المستقبل المستمر يصف نشاطاً سيكون جارياً في وقت مستقبلي.
